name: Free-path sampling
aliases: Single Scattering Volume Path Tracing with Transmittance Sampling
definition: A method that avoids both distance and spherical integrations by letting the light ray randomly bounce off in the middle of participating media before hitting a surface.
summary: Free-path sampling simulates light transport in homogeneous media by randomly determining interaction distances via the extinction coefficient, distinguishing itself by explicitly tracking stochastic flight paths to handle volume and surface events within a single traversal logic.
